result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main visual defect is the promo banner, whose white text and pale mint background give it almost no contrast. There is also a minor overlap on the first 'Fastest near you' card. The clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom are intentional and not reported.

issues.description: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is white on a very light mint background. It is nearly unreadable, and the promo code in particular is hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Use dark text, or a darker or more saturated banner background, to reach at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio. The banner is important because it carries the promo code.

issues.description: On the first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké), the '15–25 min' pill overlaps the edge of the plate image. The light card background also makes the image look washed out and lacking a clear boundary compared with the darker cards.
issues.suggestion: Move the time pill so it does not collide with the image content. Give the light image a consistent background or a subtle border or overlay so it matches the other cards.

issues.description: The 'Order now' button and the banner have low visual emphasis. The white button on the pale banner has weak separation, and the decorative circle in the banner is barely visible.
issues.suggestion: Use a filled brand-color button, or add a stronger shadow or border, so the call to action stands out.
